name: Tehila Ezeibe
message:
Happy Birthday Daddy!!! I love you so so much and want to thank you once again on this beautiful day when the Lord made you!! When you stepped into this world, the Lord made the sun shine a little more brightly. You are a wonderful father who is constantly sacrificing for the lives of others and constantly contributing to the lives of many. We wish you more grace and that the Lord would satisfy you with long life and bless you with the riches of His glory. 

Now, a final prayer of blessing grace and peace---> 
May the Lord bless you and keep you
May the Lord cause His face to shine upon you and be gracious onto you
May the lord turn His face towards you and give you His peace

And the church says... AMEN!
